minitest.scenario: Minitest::Test organization or behavior is material
minitest.expected: Trigger the profile

minitest.scenario: Minitest describe or it behavior is material
minitest.expected: Trigger the profile

minitest.scenario: Ordinary Ruby implementation has no material harness question
minitest.expected: Non-trigger

minitest.scenario: Work is exclusively RSpec-specific
minitest.expected: Non-trigger

minitest.scenario: One direct assertion proves the required observable outcome
minitest.expected: Green when the assertion can fail for the defect

minitest.scenario: Assertion or refutation polarity obscures or cannot prove the outcome
minitest.expected: Select a direct required predicate; false-passing evidence is Red

minitest.scenario: Per-test setup and teardown own a bounded resource
minitest.expected: Green or Yellow according to lifecycle and cleanup

minitest.scenario: Inherited hooks or lifecycle extensions change ordering or cleanup
minitest.expected: Inspect super, effective hooks, and versions; hidden or broken ordering is Orange or Red

minitest.scenario: Setup or test failure occurs before cleanup
minitest.expected: Verify teardown attempts and real restoration; consequential residue is Red

minitest.scenario: Tests share mutable process, class, global, environment, cache, or service state
minitest.expected: At least Yellow; uncontrolled contamination or order dependence is Red

minitest.scenario: A test outcome depends on another test's execution order
minitest.expected: Red isolation stop

minitest.scenario: A randomized-order failure is reproducible with its reported seed
minitest.expected: Preserve the seed and repair the leak; sorted order is not isolation proof

minitest.scenario: parallelize_me! is enabled for an otherwise isolated owner
minitest.expected: Verify executor, thread safety, complete results, and cleanup

minitest.scenario: Parallel tests can write one shared path, database, port, account, cache, or environment
minitest.expected: Red collision stop unless isolated before execution

minitest.scenario: Subject, plugin, mock, reporter, or helper is not thread-safe
minitest.expected: Red for parallel execution until confined, synchronized, serialized, or removed

minitest.scenario: Test claims process or subprocess integration
minitest.expected: Exercise the real process boundary with explicit status, output, timeout, cleanup, and platform assumptions

minitest.scenario: Test claims filesystem integration
minitest.expected: Exercise real filesystem semantics in an owned disposable root

minitest.scenario: Test claims database integration
minitest.expected: Exercise the real database boundary under project-owned disposable isolation and cleanup

minitest.scenario: A mocked process, filesystem, database, or service boundary is called integration
minitest.expected: Red false-integration stop

minitest.scenario: Minitest mock expectations are material
minitest.expected: Establish core or separate-gem ownership and verify meaningful expectations

minitest.scenario: Object#stub replaces one method for a bounded block
minitest.expected: Verify the target, existence, restoration, and concurrency boundary

minitest.scenario: A test replaces many collaborators or internal calls
minitest.expected: Structural warning; prefer a focused boundary, fake, or decomposition

minitest.scenario: A bounded skip records unsupported or unavailable behavior
minitest.expected: No passing evidence; a required claim depending on the skip is Red

minitest.scenario: Name filtering is used for a focused run
minitest.expected: Establish version semantics and verify that intended tests ran

minitest.scenario: minitest/autorun controls process-exit execution
minitest.expected: Inspect at-exit, fork, prior-exception, after-run, and exit-status ownership

minitest.scenario: A custom reporter changes result or output handling
minitest.expected: Verify lifecycle, complete results, failures, output safety, and compatibility

minitest.scenario: A plugin changes options, loading, reporters, or execution
minitest.expected: Establish explicit loading and exact compatibility; unsupported claims are Red

minitest.scenario: Expected tests are silently omitted or an unfiltered run collects zero tests
minitest.expected: Red truthfulness stop even when the runner returns success

minitest.scenario: Ruby, Minitest, mock, or plugin behavior is outside verified versions
minitest.expected: Red until current source and project evidence establish support

minitest.scenario: Failure output, reporter data, seed, paths, or payloads expose protected data
minitest.expected: Red; sanitize at the source and reverify artifacts

minitest.scenario: Exact command, file pattern, or worker count must be chosen
minitest.expected: Repository-owned; the profile may inspect but not select it

minitest.scenario: Repository policy is stricter than the profile fallback
minitest.expected: Stricter repository policy controls

minitest.scenario: A maintained test owner crosses warning or crisis thresholds
minitest.expected: Apply classification, decomposition, and bounded-exception rules

minitest.scenario: A test can mutate destructive or consequential external state without authority
minitest.expected: Red authority stop

minitest.scenario: The decision materially needs Minitest and Ruby semantics
minitest.expected: Pair both profiles independently under the applicable process owner

minitest.scenario: A repository is choosing between Minitest and another framework
minitest.expected: Non-trigger; framework selection remains project-owned
